extracted.intended_audience: members of the public, stakeholders, and interested parties who may wish to submit comments on proposed California EDD regulations
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for providing written feedback on proposed California EDD regulations under the Administrative Procedure Act (APA), including what counts as a regulation, procedural obligations, required timing/format, how to submit, and where responses will appear.

rubrics_metrics.name: Definition of a regulation
rubrics_metrics.description: A regulation is any rule, regulation, order, or standard adopted by a state agency to implement, interpret, or make specific the laws it enforces and administers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agency compliance with APA rulemaking procedures
rubrics_metrics.description: State agencies, including EDD, must comply with the rulemaking procedures and standards set forth in California’s Administrative Procedure Act (APA) in order to adopt a regulation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Right to provide feedback during APA rulemaking
rubrics_metrics.description: As part of the APA’s rulemaking process, you have a right to provide feedback to us about our proposed regulations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Format and timing of feedback
rubrics_metrics.description: Feedback must be provided through written comments and submitted within the APA’s permitted timeframe.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Comments that are not written or are submitted outside the APA timeframe may not be accepted or considered; ensure timeliness and that submissions are in writing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Methods for submitting comments
rubrics_metrics.description: To submit your comment, choose one of the following options: by mail, by email, or by fax.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: By Mail: EDD Legal, MIC 53, Attn: Rulemaking Comments, PO Box 826880, Sacramento, CA 94280-0001. By Email: ProposedRegulations@edd.ca.gov. By Fax: 1-916-654-9069.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agency duty to summarize and respond to public comments
rubrics_metrics.description: Public comments received will be summarized and responded to in accordance with the APA.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The agency's responses to comments are compiled in the Final Statement of Reasons, which is part of the rulemaking package submitted to the Office of Administrative Law for review.

rubrics_metrics.name: How to obtain the Final Statement of Reasons
rubrics_metrics.description: Our responses can be found in the Final Statement of Reasons of our rulemaking package that is submitted to the Office of Administrative Law for review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you would like a copy of the Final Statement of Reasons, submit your request to the contact person listed in the Notice of Proposed Rulemaking.

rubrics_metrics.name: Where to find additional resources
rubrics_metrics.description: Links and resources relevant to rulemaking and proposed regulations are provided for further information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Page lists: 2026 Rulemaking Calendar, Proposed Regulations, California Office of Administrative Law, and a 'Help' resource for assistance.
